name: Keyboard Shortcut Navigator
description: Use Alt+1 through Alt+6 to switch dashboard pages; Alt+0 triggers emergency stop.
author: Tavros Baker
code:
const root=document.createElement('div');root.className='card xp-workshop-widget';root.style.cssText='margin:16px 0;border-left:3px solid #9b5cff;padding:16px';document.getElementById('settings').append(root);root.innerHTML="

Alt+1 Controller \u00b7 Alt+2 Cheats \u00b7 Alt+3 Macros \u00b7 Alt+4 Console \u00b7 Alt+5 Settings \u00b7 Alt+6 Workshop \u00b7 Alt+0 STOP

";const pages=['controller','cheats','macros','console','settings','workshop'];const handler=e=>{if(!e.altKey||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)return;const n=Number(e.key);if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>6)return;e.preventDefault();if(n===0)xlink.stop();else xlink.navigate(pages[n-1])};window.addEventListener('keydown',handler);return()=>{root.remove();window.removeEventListener('keydown',handler);root.replaceChildren()};
